easy.def: A long, hollow pipe or case.
examples: I squeezed the tube of paste.
Water flows through a tube.
A straw is a small tube.

more.def: A long, hollow pipe, or a soft case with a cap that holds something to squeeze out.
examples: A tube carried water from the tank to the sink.
He squeezed paint out of the tube.
A drinking straw is a thin tube.
Tuesday is pizza day at school.
I have a swimming lesson on Tuesday.
Mom is home on Tuesday.

more.def: The day of the week that comes after Monday and before Wednesday.
examples: The recycling truck comes on Tuesday morning.
Our book club meets every Tuesday after school.
On Tuesday, the first snow of the year fell.

easy.def: A song or a set of notes that you can hum.
examples: I hummed a happy tune.
She plays a tune on the flute.
The tune stuck in my head.

more.def: A group of musical notes that makes a pleasing song.
examples: The band played a lively tune.
I could not get the tune out of my head.
She whistled a tune as she walked.

easy.def: A long path under the ground or through a hill.
examples: The train goes through the tunnel.
We dug a tunnel in the sand.
The tunnel is dark.

more.def: A long passage dug under the ground or through a mountain or hill.
examples: The train rushed through a tunnel in the mountain.
Moles dig tunnels under the garden.
Cars went through the tunnel under the river.

easy.def: A big bird that people eat at Thanksgiving.
examples: We ate turkey on Thanksgiving.
A wild turkey ran across the road.
The turkey is big.

more.def: A large bird with a bare head and a fan-shaped tail, raised for food or found wild.
examples: Many families eat roast turkey on Thanksgiving.
A wild turkey fanned its tail feathers to impress the others.
Turkeys can run fast and can fly for short distances.

easy.def: To go around or face a new way.
examples: Turn left here.
The wheel turns.
She turned around.

more.def: To move around a point, or to change direction.
examples: The wheels of the bus turn slowly on the icy road.
Turn left at the corner to get to the library.
He turned his head when someone called his name.
Leaves turn red.
Ice turns into water.
The sky turned dark.
Caterpillars turn into butterflies.
The leaves turn orange and gold in the fall.
The milk turned sour after sitting out all day.

easy.def: Your time to do something in a game.
examples: It is my turn.
Now it is your turn.
She waits for her turn.

more.def: The time when it is your chance to do something, one after another.
examples: Everyone gets a turn on the swing.
It is your turn to roll the dice.
We took turns reading the story aloud.

easy.def: An animal with a hard shell on its back.
examples: The turtle is slow.
A turtle hid in its shell.
The turtle crossed the road.

more.def: A slow, hard-shelled animal that lives in water or on land and can pull its head into its shell.
examples: The turtle pulled its head into its shell.
Sea turtles swim long distances.
A turtle slowly crossed the road.
